title: Boolean encoding of bounded circuit trees
statement: Equip the type of pairs $(n,C)$, where $n$ is a natural number and $C$ is a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables, with a finite encoding over the Boolean alphabet. Its encoder is the concatenated unary encoding of $n$ and the circuit-tree encoding, and its decoder is the partial decoder that accepts only fully consumed, canonically encoded lists.
